brief.subject: Class A local dry van driver

recipe.name: Home on time
recipe.hook_formula: Lead with being home: the home time the brief states (every night, weekends, so many days a month), in the reader's words. If the brief states no home time, lead with the schedule or the area that keeps the driver near home. The one fact that makes it believable goes on the second line, in a few words.
recipe.image_prompt_template: Our truck parked on a quiet {street} at {time_of_day}, a porch light on, {season}, {viewpoint}, no people, no text, no logos, no lettering

en.primary_text: 360 Logistics is hiring Class A local drivers for dedicated dry van runs in Chicagoland. Store deliveries close to home, every night in your own bed. Pay is $28 per hour, up to $32 per hour. Paid time off included. Must be 23+ with 2 years experience.
en.headline: Local. Home every night.

es.primary_text: 360 Logistics busca conductores Clase A para rutas locales de van seco en Chicago. Entregas a tiendas, en casa cada noche. Paga de $28 a $32 por hora. Tiempo libre pagado. Se requiere 23+ años y 2 años de experiencia.
es.headline: Local. En casa cada noche.
